name: Cessna Citation X (750)
summary: One of the fastest civil business jets (about Mach 0.9), built around a heavily swept wing and two Rolls-Royce AE3007 turbofans.

wings: Low wing swept far more than any other Citation (about 37 degrees)
Winglets on the X+; plain tips on earlier aircraft
engines: Two large Rolls-Royce AE3007C turbofans in pods on the rear fuselage
fuselage: Long, slim fuselage with a row of oval windows
tail: T-tail with a large, swept horizontal stabilizer on a swept fin

tellTales: Sharply swept wing on a Citation-style airframe
Large swept T-tail and big rear engine pods
Slim, long fuselage with a row of oval windows

confusedWith.howToTell: The Citation X wing is much more swept and its tailplane larger and more raked; the Sovereign has only a moderately swept wing.
The Citation III/VII has less wing sweep, smaller windows and no winglets; the Citation X looks faster, with a far more swept wing.
The Latitude has a fat, round fuselage and modest sweep; the Citation X is slimmer with extreme wing sweep.
